title: Leaked Cerimedo Audios: He Talks About Sheinbaum and Calls Negre ‘a Mercenary, Worse Than Me’
author: SinEmbargo
content:
_This article by the SinEmbargo editorial staff originally appeared in
the[September 10, 2026 edition of
SinEmbargo](https://www.sinembargo.mx/4868204/audios-de-cerimedo-habla-de-
sheinbaum-y-de-negre-dice-un-mercenario-peor-que-yo/), an independent Mexican
digital news outlet._

**Mexico City, September 10 (SinEmbargo).—** **“A real mercenary, worse than
me”** — that is how Argentine consultant Fernando Cerimedo described his
former partner at [_La Derecha Diario_](https://www.sinembargo.mx/4856876/la-
presidenta-alerta-que-la-derecha-diario-y-medios-afines-son-fabricas-de-
mentiras/), the Spaniard Javier Negre, during a conversation with his ex-
partner, Nadia Beller, that was leaked on Wednesday by the newspaper _Clarín_.

In the recording, Cerimedo explains the reasons that led him to sell his stake
in the conservative outlet and cut ties with the project — among them, that
keeping up that commercial and media relationship was causing him more and
more complications.

The fallout from that link reached even Mexican politics: in the audio, the
political adviser cites the President of Mexico, Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo, as
an example of the problems his continued involvement in the outlet was
causing.

“On top of that it brings me problems: the President of Mexico, Sheinbaum, who
is at odds with Javier Negre, sometimes calls me out in the morning as if I
were organizing campaigns against her,” the consultant is heard saying in the
audio released by _Clarín_.

Beller replies to her ex that he always ends up “paying the price for
everything the other one publishes.” The consultant agrees and insists that
the partnership with Negre was already unsustainable. “The other guy is
fierce, he’s a mercenary, really. He’s worse than me, you know,” Cerimedo
states.

![Fernando Cerimedo](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-
content/uploads/2026/09/2026-09-10-cerimedo-audios-body1.jpg)The Argentine
said in a conversation with Nadia Beller that Javier Negre was “a real
mercenary.” Photo: Fernando Cerimedo / Facebook.

> He’s a mercenary, really. He’s worse than me.
>
> Fernando Cerimedo, on Javier Negre

On this latest information about the owners of _La Derecha Diario_ , President
Sheinbaum Pardo said today that although she has not listened to the audio,
the platform’s goal is to destabilize democratic processes and promote the
right — as its name says — through very murky mechanisms, and that one of its
targets was already Mexico.

“I haven’t listened to the audio. I would have to listen to it to give a
fuller opinion, to know exactly what the audio says and be able to form an
opinion on it,” she said at her morning press conference.

Nevertheless, Sheinbaum recalled that the far-right outlet was created to
**influence elections in various Latin American countries** through resources
aimed at spreading fake news and attacks on social media.

“What’s relevant here? They themselves call it _La Derecha Diario_ [The Daily
Right]. And by people — one of them now detained for the attempted femicide of
his wife, it seems. And from there have come the ties they even have with some
companies in the United States,” she maintained.

![Claudia Sheinbaum at her press conference](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-
content/uploads/2026/09/2026-09-10-cerimedo-audios-body2.jpg)Claudia Sheinbaum
Pardo said she will listen to the new audio before giving an opinion on its
content. Photo: Presidency.

> It’s a right-wing newspaper that promotes right-wing figures through rather
> murky mechanisms.
>
> President Claudia Sheinbaum

## Cerimedo Explains Why He Sold His Stake

According to the report by _Clarín_ , Cerimedo sold Negre the 50 percent he
held in the company linked to _La Derecha Diario_ and ceased to be a
shareholder of the portal while he was detained in Santa Cruz de la Sierra,
Bolivia.

In the conversation, the consultant maintains that there was a problem
involving his then-wife, Natalia Basil, since — as they were not divorced — he
considered that the shares could become part of the division of assets.

Cerimedo also mentions a person identified as “Nelson,” whom he links to the
friction with Negre and Juan Pablo Carreira, the current director of Digital
Communication of the Argentine Presidency.

But the consultant raises another reason for leaving the partnership: staying
inside _La Derecha Diario_ meant continuing to appear publicly tied to Negre’s
publications.

“So I prefer to step away from the media side. If I leave it, I’m out,” he
says in the conversation. “It’s not worth it; financially it brings in very
little money a year,” he adds.

According to _Clarín_ , the audios were recorded on July 23, about 20 days
before the shooting Beller suffered on the steps of a hotel in Santa Cruz de
la Sierra. The lawyer handed the recordings over to the Argentine newspaper.

The audio came to light just as Beller was called to testify in Argentina in
the ANDIS case, after having publicly stated that she has relevant information
for the file.

## Sheinbaum Had Already Flagged Cerimedo

The mention of Sheinbaum stems from the Mexican leader’s remarks about the
ties among Cerimedo, Negre, and the conservative portal. At the end of August,
the head of the Executive revealed that Cerimedo was still a shareholder of
the outlet when he was detained in Bolivia, and recalled that Negre had
publicly acknowledged the Argentine as his partner.

![Nadia Beller](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-
content/uploads/2026/09/2026-09-10-cerimedo-audios-body3.jpg)Fernando
Cerimedo’s ex-partner was summoned to expand her testimony over an attack
against her. Photo: Nadia Beller / Facebook.

At that press conference she also noted that _La Derecha Diario_ had been
founded by Cerimedo and Negre, and accused the portal of **using paid accounts
and _bots_ to simulate public opinion** on social media.

Days later, on September 8, the President of Mexico suggested that Congress
investigate whether Cerimedo and his network had influenced the country’s
public opinion through social media.

## _La Derecha Diario_ and Its Digital Operation

When _La Derecha Diario_ was founded, the owning company was Madero Media
Group. Basil appeared as the main shareholder, with 85 percent; Tomás Beltrame
held 10 percent; while Ezequiel Acuña and Juan Pablo Carreira each held 2.5
percent.

However, journalistic investigations into the portal’s origin and operation
prove Cerimedo’s role in its creation and running. According to an
investigation published by **SinEmbargo** , the Argentine consultant has owned
the _La Derecha Diario_ domain since 2018 and developed the project together
with Basil.

The same work noted that, by 2025, the portal had a presence not only in
Argentina but also in Mexico, Bolivia, the United States, Colombia, Israel,
Ecuador, Honduras, and Uruguay, among other countries.

In that web, Negre took over the direction of the far-right portal and
expanded the project’s presence outside Argentina. His arrival in Mexico
coincided with a digital offensive against the government of President
Sheinbaum.

## The Investigations Into the Network

**SinEmbargo** documented in November 2025 that _La Derecha Diario_ had spread
false content and violent messages against Sheinbaum during the mobilizations
identified with the so-called Generation Z. The investigation also placed the
portal within a communication structure linked to businessman **Ricardo
Salinas Pliego**.

That investigation even recovered a statement by Cerimedo before the content
verifiers who produced the special report _Mercenarios Digitales_ [Digital
Mercenaries]. The consultant acknowledged then that _La Derecha Diario_ had
used fake accounts or _trolls_ to inflate trends on social media, though he
denied they were used to attack rivals and maintained they were employed to
manipulate algorithms.

![La Derecha Diario ties](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-
content/uploads/2026/09/2026-09-10-cerimedo-audios-body4.jpg)La Derecha Diario
maintains ties with figures of the Mexican right and of other countries.
Photo: @cerimedofernando / Instagram.

The **SinEmbargo** Data Unit also documented, during the protests of November
15, 2025, that _La Derecha Diario_ spread baseless accusations against
Sheinbaum, among them claims linking her to drug trafficking or asserting that
she had ordered protesters to be repressed.

The portal has also appeared in other investigations into the coordinated
circulation of narratives against the President. In April 2026, **SinEmbargo**
documented how far-right accounts, among them _La Derecha Diario_ , amplified
messages seeking to blame former President Andrés Manuel López Obrador (AMLO)
and President Sheinbaum for the attack that occurred in Teotihuacán.

In another investigation, **SinEmbargo** detected that the platform had gained
relevance within Salinas Pliego’s political project and documented the
businessman’s ties with Negre and other figures of the Mexican and foreign
right.

In Mexico, the topic grew because the portal attacked the President of Mexico
harshly. In fact, the federal leader herself had already denounced the
Cerimedo and Negre network before _Clarín_ brought the audio to light.
